card.fact_statement: Human Rights Watch conducted an investigation that led to the official announcement of the Catatumbo campaign in August 2019.
card.source_span: The existence of the campaign was officially announced in August 2019 after a Human Rights Watch (HRW) investigation.

target_qa_variants.question: Ni chombo kipi cha ufuatiliaji kilichofanya uchunguzi uliopelekea tangazo rasmi la kampeni ya Catatumbo mnamo Agosti 2019?
target_qa_variants.source_span: The existence of the campaign was officially announced in August 2019 after a Human Rights Watch (HRW) investigation.
target_qa_variants.translation_note: Translated 'monitoring body' to 'chombo cha ufuatiliaji'. Kept 'Human Rights Watch' as it is the established proper noun used in Swahili media.

backtranslation_en.question: Which monitoring body conducted the investigation that led to the official announcement of the Catatumbo campaign in August 2019?

backtranslation_consistency.reason: The Swahili translation accurately preserves the fact, entity, and intent of the source question without adding new constraints.
